text.p: These are the leading stories in the Moroccan press on Wednesday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Interior Minister Driss Basri says reforms trigger change, consolidate state of law and enlarge freedom.
- Palestinian Authority President Yasser Arafat replies to King Hassan's message over Hebron redeployment agreement and thanks him for his unceasing efforts in support of the Palestinian cause.
- Monetary authorities plan 10-year scheme to raise level of savings to 25 percent of Gross Domestic Product from present 19.5 percent.
- According to an Israeli radio, Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu wants to meet King Hassan on the Israeli leader's return from a trip to Washington tentatively scheduled for mid-February.
- European Union asks King Hassan to resume mediating role in the Middle East.
